description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. MCC Partner Country Business Forecast, planned compact procurements above $300K across all active Millennium Challenge Corporation compacts, published quarterly by MCC itself. INFORMATIONAL AND NON-BINDING: this forecast does not commit MCC or any MCA entity to any procurement. Real opportunities post later as live bids. US companies are generally eligible to bid; confirm with the issuing MCA entity. Filter by keyword, country, or anticipated quarter. These are forecasts, not live solicitations. Present as information only; verify every fact against the issuing MCA entity before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
